blocks.text: SINGAPORE — President Marcos is in no rush to endorse a blanket social media ban for minors after the Senate adopted a bill restricting children’s access to high-risk digital services. Marcos said his administration was examining measures adopted by other countries but said that preventing violence among youths would require a broader approach. READ: House […]...
